name: cn-study-abroad-essay
description: Coach a Chinese applicant through study-abroad application writing: the personal statement or statement of purpose, the UK undergraduate structured questions, the US application essay and supplements, the CV and the recommendation brief, built from the applicant's real experiences and written in their own voice. Use when asked 留学文书怎么写, 帮我改 PS, 个人陈述没思路, SOP 怎么写, 英国本科文书三个问题, 推荐信素材, or help me with my study abroad essays. Produces a material inventory, a positioning line, an outline per document, draft feedback against the common faults of Chinese applications, an English draft and an integrity note. Distinct from personal-statement, which is general.
